title: USERELATIONSHIP is an error where row-level security filters the table
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "x", CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], USERELATIONSHIP ( Sales[BillToKey], Customer[CustomerKey] ) ) )

expected.error: USERELATIONSHIP can't be used where row-level security is defined for the table

source.quote: USERELATIONSHIP cannot be used when row level security is defined for the table in which the measure is included.
source.supports: the documentation says the query returns an error

source.quote: if a relationship transfers a security filter, then the relationship cannot be overridden through USERELATIONSHIP
source.supports: the relationship from Customer to Sales carries the role's filter
